$description: Canonical empty Zuora Workflow envelope accepted by Workflow::Setup.import. Every generated workflow starts as a deep-clone of this object. NOTES: (1) An emitted workflow must always carry >= 1 task and >= 1 Start linkage - tasks: [] or linkages: [] causes Rails to raise 'No tasks/linkages present in import payload'. (2) workflow.parameters has a fully-shaped default (not bare {}) because the React settings UI persists these keys (workflows_controller.rb#workflow_params L706-777). (3) workflow.notifications has a fully-shaped default because Workflow#cast (workflow.rb L188-216) reads each key. (4) ui_trigger is intentionally OMITTED - it is NOT a column on the workflows table (db/schema.rb L432-508) and Workflow::Setup.import slices the input against Workflow.column_names (workflow/setup.rb L417), silently dropping unknown keys.
